newsitem.title: USA: Cell Genesys drops suit against Genpharm.
newsitem.headline: Cell Genesys drops suit against Genpharm.

text.p: Cell Genesys Inc on Monday said it dropped its lawsuit against GenPharm International Inc relating to transgenic mice technology.

In a filing in Santa Clara County Superior Court in California, Cell Genesys noted a patent was issued to GenPharm on January 7 that includes claims related to transgenic mice whose antibody genes have been inactivated. GenPharm has filed suit against Abgenix Inc, a unit of Cell Genesys, for infringement of that patent, Cell Genesys said.
The filing said while Cell Genesys believed its suit had merit, it chose not to proceed at this time in light of the issuance of the patent.

The filing emphasized Cell Genesys would continue to pursue protection of the technology at issue before the United States Patent and Trademark Office, in federal court, and, if appropriate in the future, in state court.
